definitions.short: fear ; by implication, a fearful thing or deed
definitions.usage: dread, (that ought to be) fear(-ed), terribleness, terror.
definitions.full: H4172. mora מוֺרָא noun masculine Deut 4:34 fear , ׳מ Mal 2:5 3 t.; מֹרָא Deut 26:8 ; suffixes מוֺרָאִי Mal 1:6 ; מוֺרָאוֺ Isa 8:12 ; מוֺרַאֲכֶם 8:13 2 t.; plural מוֺרָאִים Deut 4:34 ; — 1 fear, terror , || חַת Gen 9:2 (P); || מַּחַד Deut 11:25 . 2 reverence: מוֺרָאִי אַיֵּה where is the reverence due to me Mal 1:6 . 3 object of reverence , especially God Isa 8:12-13 , Psa 76:12 ; || בְּרִית Mal 2:5 . 4 awe-inspiring spectacle or deed ׳(ה)מ (ה)גּדול(יםׅ Deut 4:34 ; 26:8 ; 34:12 ; Jer 32:21 . מוֺרָה noun [masculine] לָהֶם מוֺרָה שִׁיתָה Psalm 9:21, probably appoint ( Hosea 6:11 ) terror (i.e. some awe-inspiring exhibition of power) for them Thes SS RV Ew De Hu Pe Che after Masora, ᵑ7 Aq Jerome ( מוֺרָה a variation of or probably error for מוֺרָא ); possibly set them a teacher, master Bae after מוֺרֶה ᵑ6 ᵑ9 ᵐ5 , νομοθέτην ; neither altogether satisfactory.
